trust_decision.summary: Worker mode decides between requests that per-request PHP session state (PS(id), session vars, status) belongs to the previous client and must be cleared; the reset lives in frankenphp_worker_request_shutdown and is compiled out entirely when ext/session is not linked at build time (HAVE_PHP_SESSION undefined, i.e. session built as a shared module).

landing_point.why: Summary says 'session ID leak in worker mode'; grep for PS(id) leads straight to frankenphp_reset_session_state and its #ifdef HAVE_PHP_SESSION gate at frankenphp.c:436/503.

fix_sites.entry_point: PHP userland frankenphp_handle_request() in a worker script (frankenphp.c:816), via frankenphp_worker_request_shutdown (frankenphp.c:896) and frankenphp_worker_request_startup reload loop (frankenphp.c:593-599); also boot dummy request via frankenphp_shutdown_dummy_request (threadworker.go:211 -> frankenphp.c:521-526)
fix_sites.module_kind: core C SAPI (single file, module-reload table)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: Single-line table edit at frankenphp.c:67; the RINIT counterpart at frankenphp.c:593-599 is reached through the same table, not a separate module.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The PS(in_save_handler) reset at frankenphp.c:1537-1548 is gated by the same HAVE_PHP_SESSION macro but sits in the non-worker php_thread loop and addresses a lock-leak bug (#2368), not cross-client data exposure, so a solver can call it a neighbouring feature.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Session save handlers registered by the worker bootstrap before the request loop must survive between requests (PS(mod_user_names)/class preserved); unconditionally adding 'session' to MODULES_TO_RELOAD, or calling session RSHUTDOWN in linked builds too, frees them. The project's own test checks this behaviour.

O6_input_shapes: build where session is a shared module (HAVE_PHP_SESSION undefined): reset via module_registry RSHUTDOWN/RINIT
build where session is statically linked: unchanged frankenphp_reset_session_state path

O7_producer.where: HAVE_PHP_SESSION comes from php_config.h, pulled in through SAPI.h (frankenphp.c:2) before the gate at frankenphp.c:9; the cgo flags at cgo.go:3-10 never define it

O8_uncovered_routes.route: PS(in_save_handler) reset before php_request_shutdown is also compiled out when session is shared, so the #2368 save-handler lock leak returns on shared-module builds; the published fix leaves it alone
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different symptom (lock or resource leak after a bailout in a user handler, not a session ID leak) and it is on the classic-mode/script-exit path rather than the per-request worker reset
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, about 1000 lines from the fix site

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a superglobal-reset step that relies on session headers/macros behind HAVE_PHP_SESSION (e.g. clearing PS(http_session_vars) beside the $_SESSION symbol-table delete)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The function already special-cases $_SESSION at frankenphp.c:374-379; a maintainer could plausibly have moved the PS() cleanup there behind the same build-time gate.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a separate list of modules to re-RINIT that drifts from the RSHUTDOWN list
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The startup and shutdown loops iterate the same table independently; splitting them into two arrays is a plausible refactor that would leave session RINIT or RSHUTDOWN missing.

O9_family: cross-request state leak / improper per-request reset in long-lived worker (CWE-488 exposure to wrong session, CWE-362)

O10_build.toolchain: Go toolchain plus a ZTS libphp (embed SAPI) built from source; reproducing the bug needs PHP built with session as a shared extension (--enable-session=shared) loaded via extension=session.so
O10_build.project_tests: frankenphp_test.go:414-436 (testSession), frankenphp_test.go:1182-1360 (TestSessionHandlerReset_worker, TestSessionHandlerPreLoopPreserved_worker, TestSessionNoLeakBetweenRequests_worker, TestSessionNoLeakAfterExit_worker); caddy/caddy_test.go:2152 (#2368 lock leak)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Drop the #ifdef HAVE_PHP_SESSION and include php_session.h unconditionally to call frankenphp_reset_session_state; this either fails to link or binds to ps_globals that are not in libphp when session is a shared .so, so it does not fix the shared-module case.

out_of_scope_notes: Other shared extensions with request-scoped globals are not reset between worker requests (only 'filter' is in MODULES_TO_RELOAD at frankenphp.c:67); that is generic worker-mode state, not this advisory's session protection.
putenv()/sandboxed_env persists across worker requests by design (docs/internals.md:232).
unverified: Whether the hidden-test harness can build a ZTS libphp with session as a shared module offline; the default static builds (build-static.sh:80, static-builder-musl.Dockerfile:78) link session in, so they never hit the bug.
O8 present_in_latest is unknown: no latest release was provided.
The O8 route's property (lock leak after a save-handler bailout) is adjacent to the advisory's ID-leak property rather than the same one; whether it counts as in scope is a judgement call.
O1=2 counts the per-request handle_request path and the boot dummy-request shutdown, which reach the same function; there is effectively one sink and one change site.

The fix's own comment (fix.diff:50-52) says pre-loop save handlers are freed on shared builds, so the published fix itself breaks the O5 behaviour on those builds; graders must not require O5 to hold on shared builds.
